So, a couple cool things in my Docker journey this weekend:

1) I learned about an alternative front-end for YouTube called Invidious. It’s pretty cool. You can self-host it. And they’re on the Fedi: @invidious@social.tchncs.de

2) I migrated the Minecraft server that I set up for the kids over to a Docker container (it was previously a VM). I don’t play Minecraft myself, but they seem to enjoy it. They were complaining about lag on the old version so I’m interested to see how it performs in Docker.

#Docker #SelfHosting
